final_answer:
It is not possible to tile an 8x8 chessboard with two opposite corners removed using 2x1 dominoes. Here's why:

An 8x8 chessboard has 64 squares, evenly split between black and white (32 each). When two opposite corners are removed, both squares removed are of the same color (since opposite corners on a chessboard are always the same color). This leaves 30 squares of one color and 32 of the other. 

Each 2x1 domino always covers one black and one white square. Therefore, to fully tile the board, the number of black and white squares must be equal. Since removing two opposite corners creates an imbalance (30 vs. 32), it becomes impossible to pair all remaining squares with dominoes. 

Thus, tiling the modified board with dominoes is not possible.
